svg.title: Zip-tie station placement
svg.desc: Two top views of one plate of the two-sided puller, before left and after right, the plug end at the top. Left: the defaults with plug length set to 40, a 20 mm wide plug in teal. Right: zip-tie station placement set to Manual. Marked in red: 1, the arms: the two toothed arms in the upper half. 2, the zip stations: the three small holes along each arm. 3, the strap slot: the long slot in each arm.
